<thought>We need the number of chemically equivalent hydrogen atoms (unique proton environments) for the compound in question. The only way to obtain this information is to request the 1H NMR spectrum, which will list the distinct signals corresponding to unique hydrogen environments. The tool proton_nmr_spectra requires no arguments and should return the spectrum for the target compound that the task is about. We'll call it and then count the distinct signals.</thought>
<action>proton_nmr_spectra</action>
<action_input>{}</action_input>
